description: A PHP class extending ChartsApiController that provides administrative API endpoints for generating statistical data and reports related to investments, projects, and financial metrics within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes methods for aggregating data, time slot calculations, and detailed financial summaries.

classes.name: AdminChartsApiController
classes.description: PHP controller class providing API endpoints for statistical data access, extending ChartsApiController with specialized methods for admin use.

methods.name: aggregatesAction
methods.description: Generates aggregated statistical data over time, based on filters and project type ('invests' or 'projects').

methods.name: totalInvestsAction
methods.description: Calculates total invested amounts for various categories like raised, active, refunded, etc., over specified time slots and filters.

methods.name: totalProjectsAction
methods.description: Returns statistical totals for projects, such as creation, negotiation, reviewing, publication, and rejection over different time periods.
